description: Main source file for a Flutter-based Tic Tac Toe app, defining the main application widget, game screen, game logic, and UI components.

classes.name: TicTacToeApp
classes.description: The root widget of the application setting up themes, colors, and routing to the game screen.

classes.name: GameScreen
classes.description: Stateful widget managing the game state, user interactions, and UI layout for the Tic Tac Toe game.

classes.name: _GameScreenState
classes.description: State class managing the game logic, state variables, and UI rebuilds.

classes.name: _Board
classes.description: Stateless widget rendering the Tic Tac Toe grid and handling cell interactions.

classes.name: _BoardCell
classes.description: Representing individual cells in the game grid with styling and tap handling.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Entry point that runs the TicTacToeApp.

methods.name: _hexToColor
methods.description: Converts a hex color string to a Flutter Color object.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Build method for TicTacToeApp setting up MaterialApp with theme and home screen.

methods.name: _reset
methods.description: Resets the game to initial state.

methods.name: _handleTap
methods.description: Handles user interaction on board cell taps, updating game state.

methods.name: _checkWin
methods.description: Checks if the current player has won the game.

methods.name: _playerLabel
methods.description: Returns a string label ('X' or 'O') for a player.

methods.name: _playerColor
methods.description: Returns a color for a player (X uses primary, O uses secondary).

methods.description: Build method for the game screen UI including header, board, and footer.
